prompt:
Draw exactly8 whole-body sprites, two rows of4, same approved character and armor as references. TRUE LEFT SIDE PROFILE, walking toward screen LEFT. Top row Requiem with long black sleeved coat. Bottom row Rock with sleeveless vest, skull shirt, bare arms. Keep small dark red aura, brown hair, red iris, skin. Use reference ONLY for costume, head, armor and scale; create new natural low WALK poses, not fighting poses. Real transparent background, clear gutters, no text.

These are the SECOND HALF of a side walk cycle. The leg NEAREST THE VIEWER (character's left leg) is BACK behind the hips toward screen RIGHT at start. The OTHER/FAR LEG reaches LEFT for heel contact, seen behind the near thigh. Reverse the limb overlap from normal leading-near-leg reference. The NEAR ARM swings FORWARD toward screen LEFT; far arm swings BACK toward screen RIGHT. Shoulders relaxed, hands low by hips, elbows nearly straight.

Each row four frames:
1 FAR LEG extended modestly FORWARD LEFT with heel contact, NEAR LEG extended BACK RIGHT with toe support. Near arm forward. Near thigh is the most visible thigh and slopes from pelvis to screen-right knee.
2 FAR LEG under hips supporting, NEAR knee low behind/right as its heel rolls up. Near arm starts returning.
3 FAR LEG straight vertical under hips holding weight. NEAR leg swings forward beside supporting ankle, foot only just above ground, near arm travels back. No raised knee.
4 NEAR LEG extends forward LEFT ready for next heel strike, FAR LEG trails RIGHT with heel up. Near arm behind.

All eight are WALKING. Do not lift knee toward chest, do not make combat stance, do not make long sprinting stride. Both boots never far off floor. Same low ground baseline/head size across frames. Feet and hands completely visible. Crisp game sprite art.
